verdict.rationale: Customer.io is an automation platform: its automations are workflows fired by triggers such as events or segment membership, and an AI agent can create and manage them through the official MCP server. The agent can also run recurring tasks on a schedule (Daily Routines), which is true background operation rather than a one-off action. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that agent-built automations and scheduled agent tasks run reliably unattended, and deeper docs on scheduled-task configuration, limits and monitoring.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: An automation is a workflow to send messages and manipulate data in Customer.io.
You can trigger automations when profiles perform events, when they join Segments (e.g. they meet attribute conditions), and so on.
create and manage automations and one-time sends, work with segments, and more—all through natural language prompts.
You can set up recurring tasks that the agent runs automatically on a schedule—like deliverability reports, segment audits, and broadcast recaps.
